The main actions (conducting causal analysis and studying the root cause) are explicitly stated, but the comment lacks concrete details on how to implement them—authors are not told how to perform the causal analysis or how to carry out the aggregation-process study. Thus, the comment is actionable in direction but provides only high-level suggestions rather than concrete implementation guidance.
